Near-term capacity inflection; execution risk but could unlock higher volumes and margins.
SK On U.S. LFP cell supply 2027–2031

Aims to highlight underlying ops as scaling begins; watch for path to profitability.
Adds liquidity for working capital; increases leverage and execution scrutiny.
